_meta.purpose: Curated adverse/context media with ARTICLE permalinks (not outlet homepages).

klarna.headline: Sweden's Klarna discloses 24% revenue surge in much-awaited U.S. IPO filing
klarna.verbatim_quote: Klarna's revenue grew to $2.81 billion in the year ended Dec. 31 compared with $2.28 billion a year ago. It earned $21 million, compared with a loss of $244 million, a year ago.
